companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Companies to score. Each item can be a company domain (stripe.com), an ATS career URL or board slug (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/linear, greenhouse:stripe), or an object with name, domain and/or board. Duplicates are merged. The Actor auto-detects Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee and public Workday boards.

departments.title: Department filter
departments.description: Optional. Keep only jobs whose department or team contains one of these words (case-insensitive). Counts, velocity and the momentum score use the filtered set.

locations.title: Location filter
locations.description: Optional. Keep only jobs whose location contains one of these words (e.g. Remote, United States, London).

snapshotStore.title: Snapshot store name
snapshotStore.description: Named Apify key-value store used to remember each company's open roles between runs, so new and closed roles can be diffed. Use a dedicated store per workspace if several teams share the account.

skipSnapshot.title: Skip snapshot read/write
skipSnapshot.description: If enabled, do not read or write the named snapshot store. New-roles-since-last-run will be empty; weekly velocity still uses posted dates when the board publishes them.

maxNewRoles.title: Max new roles listed
maxNewRoles.description: How many new roles (since the last snapshot) to include in each company result. The count is always complete.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies in this run
maxCompanies.description: Hard cap on how many input companies are processed (and charged) in this run. Duplicates are merged before the cap is applied to unique companies only after parse order; prefer de-duplicating the list yourself.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests to official job-board APIs and career pages.
